DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSES OF BENIGN PROSTATIC HYPERPLASIA
Differential Diagnoses
- Prostate Cancer
- Bladder Cancer
- Bladder neck stenosis/ contracture
- Bladder neck dysnerrgia
- Urinary Tract Infection
- Urethral stricture
- External sphincter dyssynergia
- Bladder calculus
- Prostatitis
- Neurological Diseases
- Bladder wall diseases, especially chronic schistosomiasis and tuberculosis
of the bladder.
Complications
- Urinary retention
- Recurrent Urinary Tract Infection
- Bladder calculus
- chronic renal insufficiency & Acute renal failure
- Haematuria
- Obstructive uropathy
